From: Lesley Groff
To: Jefffrey Epstein <jeevacation@grnail.com>
Subject: Fwd: 2017 Pritzker Architecture Prize Ceremony Invitation
Date: Mon, 17 Apr 2017 11:59:53 +0000
Attachments: Pritzker 2017Ceremony_Invitation.pdf; Pritzlcer_2017Ceremony_RSVPCard_4PM.pdf

Shall I RSVP no to this event May 20th in Tokyo?
Begin forwarded message:
From: Eunice Kim <I
Subject: 2017 Pritzker Architecture Prize Ceremony Invitation
Date: April 4, 2017 at 10:23:47 PM EDT
To: jeevacation@gmail.com,
Dear Mr. Epstein,
On behalf of the Pritzker Family, we kindly request the pleasure of your company at a ceremony to honor the 2017 Laureates of the
Pritzker Architecture Prize, Rafael Aranda, Carme Pigem and Ramon Villa, in the presence of members the Imperial Family of
Japan, on Saturday, May 20th in Tokyo. The ceremony will begin at 5:30pm at the State Guest House, Akasaka Palace; and the dinner
reception will take place at 7:00pm at the Grand Hyatt Tokyo.
Please find attached, corresponding information and details. For inquiries or to RSVP, please feel free to respond to me directly.

Best,
Eunice

Eunice Kim
Director of Communications
Pritzker Architecture Prize
